limits: MERGEABLE is evaluated against each current base, not against sibling forks or a final combined runtime.
API observations of successful CI are not local test executions and do not establish gameplay, artistic fidelity, controller QA or deployment.
Workbook inspection uses the actual pinned Git blobs, ZIP relationships and worksheet XML hashes; no native Excel rendering or formula calculation was performed.
Common changed paths and different blobs establish a reconciliation requirement; no cross-fork merge conflict was simulated.
The 1200 mission variants remain design records unless separately implemented; source fidelity, multiplayer and V85 territorial progression are not promoted by this report.
The PR list is a dated snapshot. PR62 and PR63 were treated as active work; later PR64 and PR65 are listed without content audit.
